story.head: Bruisers vs. finesse
paras: The Blackhawks (6-14-2) lost 4-2 to Columbus on Nov 19, while the Rangers have won three straight. Going in, the Rangers are third in the Metropolitan (tied for 12th in the NHL) and the Blackhawks last in the Central (31st).

The Rangers’ record (.614) is about what their chances are worth. The Blackhawks haven’t played well, but their record (.318) is worse than their play: their chances are worth about .393, and their goaltending has held them back.
This season, the Rangers have outscored teams 67-58, but only 42-40 at 5-on-5. On special teams, they’ve outscored teams 15-9.

The Rangers lean on their stars as much as almost anyone (2nd lowest), get more of their shots from in close than almost anyone (2nd) and get a lot of their shots blocked (32nd). As for the Blackhawks, they pick their shots (lowest), don’t block many shots (32nd) and have struggled on the power play (31st). Chicago has scored 2.45 goals a game, the second fewest in the league, and allowed 4.05, the second most. The Rangers hit a lot, but the Hawks mostly don’t. On top of that, the Rangers’ forecheck could keep the Blackhawks pinned in their own end.

Adam Fox (2 G / 22 A / 24 P in 22 GP) leads the Rangers in scoring, and Alexis Lafrenière (10 G / 12 A / 22 P in 22 GP) has a team-high ten goals. For the Blackhawks, Sam Rinzel (1 G / 13 A / 14 P in 21 GP) leads the way in scoring, with nine points in his last five games. Frank Nazar (11 G / 2 A / 13 P in 20 GP) has a team-high eleven goals.
Dylan Garand (7-7-1 / .910 SV% in 13 GS) will likely start for the Rangers, and Spencer Knight (6-11-1 / .886 SV% in 18 GS) for Chicago.

items.text: The Rangers are newly without Pavel Dorofeyev and Oliver Bjorkstrand, and have been without Igor Shesterkin and Sean Durzi for several games. Dylan Garand is expected to start.
The Blackhawks are newly without Connor Bedard, and have been without Bowen Byram since Oct 13.
Roman Kantserov has nine goals on chances worth about 4.5 goals, well above what his finishing usually turns chances into. Runs like that tend to cool off.
Frank Nazar has scored in four straight games.
